tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “What are you doing after the lesson?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. Choose the right future: will for a quick decision or a prediction, going to for a plan, the present continuous for an arrangement. Change the blue word if you need to.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Going to – it's a plan, not a quick decision.
